from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/sar-allah-khon-khuda-ya-hsin-ya-husain.md')
_, header, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = []
for line in body.strip().splitlines():
    line = re.sub(r'"'^'"\\d+\\. ', '', line)
    line = re.sub(r'\\.\\.\\(\\d+\\)"'$'"', '', line)
    line = line[:1].upper() + line[1:]
    for name in ('husain', 'husaina', 'khuda', 'mustafa', 'alqama', 'karbala', 'zahra', 'sakina', 'akbar', 'zainul eba', 'nabi', 'zainab', 'zafar'):
        line = re.sub(r'\\b' + name + r'\\b', name.title(), line)
    roman.append(line)

item.text:
Reconstructed all 33 Urdu verses across 11 numbered blocks in the selected lyric. Preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, removed repeat cues, set the direction to `rtl`, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

Two uncertain readings were rendered as written in the Roman transcription: `teero jawa` as `تیر و جوا` and `Hauz ye tha bapa` as `حوض یہ تھا بپا`.
